title: eludite.git.cherry_pick input
description: Cherry-pick a commit onto the current branch (the Git Repository window's Cherry-Pick): a new commit with its change, message and author. On a conflict it stops with the conflicted paths; stage each resolved file and eludite.git.commit completes the pick. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
